results.title: Cinebench 2024 – Benchmark Intel Core i9-9900K, Gigabyte GeForce RTX™ 3090 EAGLE OC 24G 2024-03-27 22 57 08-Greenshot CROP NO LOGO.png
results.desc: Benchmark results of the system with the CPU "Intel Core i9-9900K" and the GPU "Gigabyte GeForce RTX™ 3090 EAGLE OC" under Windows 11 23H2. While the CPU spits out mediocre results for 2024, the GPU was able to deliver passable values. The comparative values mostly include older CPUs, for whatever reason. The Cinebench logo has been removed for copyright reasons. Strangely, the program does not start on screens with 8K resolution, but with 4K on the first screen and 8K output on the second monitor it worked. The "MP ratio" is obtained with divisor "Multi core score" and divisor "Single core score".

results.title: 14-ый провал Intel Зачем появились 14900K, 14700K и 14600K-00.08.39.355 (Мой Компьютер).png
results.desc: Three generations on the LGA1700 socket are the result of AMD's competition, something that hasn't happened since LGA775. But is it worth taking the new refresh? What did Intel hide when it introduced the Core 14? We reveal all the nuances of the updated Raptor Lake. Top processors Top graphics cards 00:00 - MC introduction 01:19 - History of the LGA1700. Intel Core 12th, 13th Gen 04:06 - Raptor Lake refresh theory 10:54 - Intel Core i9-14900K tests 16:45 - Intel Core i7-14700K tests 18:51 - Intel Core i5-14600K tests 19:41 - MC conclusions Uploader's note: Intel's 14th Intel Core generation has been the subject of much criticism. On the one hand, the very low performance increase compared to the 13th generation was criticized, which can be leveled by overclocking the Intel Core i9-13900K. In addition, the 13th and 14th Intel Core CPUs are sometimes very unstable and have a real risk of irreversible damage during operation.
